text:
maria: FYI — security feed flagged two CVEs that could affect inference stack: CVE-2025-1987 (sentencepiece deserialization) and CVE-2025-2072 (protobuf parsing overflow). Seen referenced in a vLLM wheel rollout and a FlashAttention test image.
kevin: Which components are impacted? Triton containers, vLLM workers, or both?
maria: Initial triage: sentencepiece exploit vector mainly relevant when user-supplied tokenizers/models are accepted (private import flows). protobuf parsing affects older grpc/proto bindings used by some Triton integrations.
dev-bot: Advisory posted: https://security-advisories.example/CVE-2025-1987 and https://security-advisories.example/CVE-2025-2072
samir: Infra can do a staged image rollout (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) but we need a signed build artifact and a rolling-restart playbook. Also recommend enabling request-level audit logging on artifact import endpoints during the window.
taylor: Do we accept uploaded tokenizers on hosted? If so, risk surface increases.
maria: Hosted stores artifacts in a scanned bucket. Private deployments and onboarding jobs allow uploads directly. Treat private imports as high risk; hosted is mitigated but still needs scanning verification.
kevin: Mitigation plan proposal:
1) pin sentencepiece to patched release in builders and wheels
2) rebuild vLLM wheel and FlashAttention test images
3) build Triton images with patched proto libs
4) push to staging, run tokenization fuzz tests + proto parse fuzzers
5) canary rollout with monitoring
samir: I'll open infra ticket for rollout slots and confirm ephemeral signing so we don't break existing verifiers. ETA for canary slot: tomorrow 09:00 PT.
taylor: I'll add audit logging to artifact-import lambda (uploader id, artifact sha, headers). PR tonight.
devsec: We'll run dependency scans, update the internal advisory (ADVISORY-2025-042), and notify enterprise accounts with a short blurb. No evidence of exploitation so far.
maria: Quick rebuild commands for engineering:
```bash
# wheel build
pip wheel --no-deps -w dist sentencepiece==X.Y.Z
# rebuild vllm
docker build -t redwood/vllm:patch-1758743210 .
# push
docker push redwood/vllm:patch-1758743210
```
kevin: Risk priority: protobuf parsing vuln = HIGH (Triton edges), sentencepiece = MED-HIGH (private import flows). Prioritize Triton image rollouts for Dedicated/Private customers.
maria: Action owners: @maria update deps & wheels, @taylor run malicious artifact smoke tests, @samir coordinate rollout & signing, @devsec maintain advisory & scans.
dev-bot: Incident ticket created: ADVISORY-2025-042
samir: Rolling restart playbook updated at infra/playbooks/rolling-restart.md. Will coordinate maintenance windows.
maria: Let's reconvene tomorrow 09:30 PT for go/no-go before canary. Ping this thread for any new findings :hand:
kevin: ack :thumbsup:
